quote: Built around fresh seasonal fruit, so naturally fruit-forward, though parfaits include dairy and wheat-based items.
found: Cited root carries only corporate copy —「日本のフルーツ専門企業として、フルーツの可能性を追求し」— and no menu at all. The company's SEASONAL SPECIAL MENU page is where the food is: 「◎シャインマスカットパフェ 2,400円」「◎シャインマスカットとワッフルの盛合せ 1,900円」「◎シャインマスカットタルト 1,400円」「◎シャインマスカットとパンナコッタの盛合せ」「◎国産ブルーベリーのチーズケーキ」「◎水蜜桃ヨーグルト」「■金澤パフェ【プリン】810円」.
http: 200 plain curl on root (20.2 KB); 200 iPhone UA; 200 on /seasonal/ (31.4 KB) and /kanazawa-parfait/ (5.3 KB)
method: 1 plain fetch of the cited root, then two same-site subpage fetches (route 1 sufficed; no proxy or Wayback needed)
note: Repoint to https://www.murahata.co.jp/seasonal/. The root evidences nothing about food. The seasonal page evidences the wheat side hard — ワッフル and タルト are sold as parfait accompaniments — and the dairy side (プリン, パンナコッタ, チーズケーキ, ヨーグルト). Strictly, no page says wheat is IN the parfait glass; what is documented is wheat items served alongside on the same plate/counter, so word it that way. Trading: active, news items dated 2026/08/14 and 2026/08/01; head office 金沢市武蔵町2-12, parlour 東山3-2-18.

why: The published menu is not wheat-free but it is not wheat-only either: 「◎まるごと夕張メロン 2,500円」「■フルーツごろごろジュレMIX 648円」「◎シャインマスカットソーダ 700円」「◎水蜜桃ヨーグルト」 are whole fruit, jelly, soda and yoghurt items that contain no wheat by construction, sold beside the ワッフル/タルト items. 'no' reads as 'nothing here is safe', which is wrong for a fruit parlour; 'ask' is honest because the company publishes no allergen policy anywhere on its site.

found: Category line 「野町駅/そば､ うどん」; reviewer 「福島屋さんといううどん・そば・丼のお店があります…メニューを見ると、うどんやお蕎麦、素麺や冷やし中華、そして各種丼をやられてます。今回は天ぷらうどん（1,200円）を注文」; menu keyword block lists ざるそば・天ぷらうどん・鍋焼きうどん・にしんそば・素麺・冷やし中華. The strings アレルギー, グルテン and 小麦 return zero hits on the whole page.
http: 200 (s.tabelog.com, iPhone UA, 517 KB); desktop host not needed
method: 1 mobile-host Tabelog fetch + whole-page string search for アレルギー/グルテン/小麦/醤油/出汁
note: The venue-specific halves hold: wheat udon, somen, chilled ramen and tempura share this one small lunch-only kitchen with the soba, and the listing is completely silent on allergens. The 'share boiling water and fryers' detail is inference, not something the page states — reword as 'wheat udon, somen, chilled ramen and tempura are cooked in the same kitchen' and it becomes fully sourced. Trading OK: 11:30-14:30 Mon-Wed/Fri-Sun, 木曜定休, no 閉店 banner; note the shop is at 片町2丁目 behind 香林坊東急スクエア even though Tabelog files it under 野町駅.

quote: As a traditional sushi restaurant, soy sauce (which normally contains wheat) is integral to the meal; no gluten-free or wheat-free soy sauce is documented.
found: Official shop copy on the cited page: 「オリジナルの寿司酢や醤油で味わう寿司をはじめ」 and the PR headline 「“新鮮さ”にこだわった関西寿司◆オリジナルの寿司酢や醤油で」, expanded as 「当店オリジナルブレンドの寿司酢を使用◎また醤油も、素材が引き立つようオリジナルの味付け」. たまり, タマリ, グルテン, 小麦 and アレルギー all return zero hits.
method: 1 mobile-host Tabelog fetch + string search for 醤油/たまり/グルテン/小麦/アレルギー
note: Better evidenced than the record realises: this is not just 'sushi implies soy sauce' — the shop's own copy makes soy sauce a signature, an in-house blend it seasons itself, and gives no ingredient list. A celiac cannot even fall back on 'it's a known bottled brand'. Worth adding the 「オリジナルの…醤油」 quote to the record. Trading OK: 定休日 日曜日, live reservation calendar showing dates from 8/21, 162 reviews, no 閉店 banner.
